plan: docs/BRD4_HOU_NEXT_STEPS_PLAN_20261101.md §5; statistics as docs/SMALL_MOLECULE_BENCHMARK_DESIGN.md §9 and scripts/rank_hou_sampling.py
fixed: 2026-11-01, after the BRD4-5 alprazolam re-run finished and before any v2 statistic was computed
decided_by: Claude, within the plan; groups and exclusions are not user wording
direction: dG kcal/mol and MM/PBSA score: lower = stronger; positive rho = agreement

scores.aggregation: replica time mean from frames.csv (not the rounded summary CSVs), then equal-weight mean of 3 replicas; SE = sd(replica means)/sqrt(3)
scores.grid_choice: both grids reported in full; neither chosen by correlation

itc_15C_same_protocol.role: main: ITC at 15 C, HEPES/150 mM NaCl, reverse titration, three papers of one lab protocol

alphascreen_cross_paper: different papers; BRD4-10 assay not confirmed
censored_same_assay: Vidler 2013 single-concentration AlphaScreen: BRD4-2 32% inhibition vs BRD4-1 inactive at 250 uM -> BRD4-2 taken as stronger (qualitative)

statistics.point: Spearman rho, Kendall tau-b, concordant/discordant/tied pairs, exact two-sided permutation p (rank_hou_sampling.exact_statistics)
statistics.sampling_bootstrap: per sample resample 3 replicas with replacement, then circular contiguous time blocks of 1 ns or 5 ns within each drawn replica (1-ns block means from frames.csv); 10000 draws, seed 20261101; 2.5-97.5 percentiles; conditions on visited states
statistics.candidate_bootstrap: resample candidates with fixed sample means; undefined (constant) draws counted
statistics.pair_fraction: fraction of sampling draws in which sample i scores stronger than j (1 ns blocks)
statistics.experimental_error: maintainer SEM listed, no distribution assigned

notes: Experimental ITC dG values are at 15 C (288 K) where stated; MD at 298.15 K; scores are entropy-free and only ordered
changes: BRD4-5 scores from the alprazolam re-prep (docs/BRD4_5_REPREP_PLAN_20261101.md; package brd4_5_alprazolam_20261101, model alprazolam_gaff_fix, job 22051 yayoi28): same protocol, 3 x (0,5] ns, default and h0.4
BRD4-5 re-enters the groups; the v1 exclusion and the _incl_BRD4-5_mismatch sensitivity groups are dropped
itc_15C_same_protocol_excl_BRD4-5 (= v1 main group) kept for continuity
same-source pair BRD4-5/BRD4-7 is now interpretable
